Introduction to PGC

Designed forBusiness & Stay

Located in Daejang-dong, Pangyo, Pangyo Global Campus is a high-end terrace residence where nature and seasonal terrace living come together.

Designed for employees, global partners, and visitors, it offers a premium business residence experience that seamlessly connects work, relaxation, and meaningful interactions in a refined and comfortable environment.

A place where business and comfort connect naturally.

Well-Connected Location

PGC LocationAdvantage

25, Pangyodaejang-ro 2-gil, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si (Daejang-dong 596)

  • Traffic

    Ultra-fast connectivity via Seopangyo Tunnel, GTX-A Seongnam Station, Seopangyo Station, Shinbundang Line, Bundang Line, and Seopangyo IC.

  • Infra

    Hyundai Department Store in Pangyo New Town, Seoul National University Hospital, Homeplus, and commercial & neighborhood facilities within Pangyo Daejang District.

  • Tourist spot

    Lotte Premium Outlet Uiwang, Lotte World, Seoul Grand Park, Gangnam COEX, Myeongdong.

  • Eco

    A nature-inspired setting with easy access to Gogiri Valley, Cheonggyesan, Gwanggyosan, and Barasan Recreational Forest.

  • Head Office21 km30 min by car
  • Gimpo International Airport50 km90 min by car
  • Incheon International Airport75 km90 min by car
